IELTS Essentials

IELTS Essential is a self-study course for students aiming for a band 5.5 IELTS score. You will focus on expanding your vocabulary and focusing on grammar that directly applies to certain IELTS question types.  Each week, we focus on two key skills that will improve your approach to answering questions, while preparing you for academic skills that will transfer into higher band scores and further study.

Complete each module, week by week.
